title: Pure Sine 440
description: A plain SinOsc at 440 Hz. The smallest thing tropical does.

title: Ring Mod
description: Two SinOscs (220 Hz × 331 Hz) multiplied through a VCA — dissonant partials.

title: Through-Zero Flanger
description: A stateless through-zero flanger: an LFO sweeps the two offset taps of a reversible comb through zero on a 110 Hz modal drone. The ahead tap reads the future.

title: Through-Zero Saw
description: A playground PatchGraph: a 110 Hz polyBLEP saw through a through-zero flanger patched from delay, ring and mix. The delay time is an LFO, so the tap sweeps through zero and reads ahead.

title: Spectral Filter FM
description: A 128-partial harmonic saw (a partial family, phase-exact at any τ) under a complex spectral lowpass envelope whose cutoff an LFO sweeps — slow, or up into audio rate for filter FM. The envelope multiplies each partial by the filter shape at its own frequency; there is no filter state.
